versions.content: The RTE shall unambiguously map together a call ISignal to a response ISignal When a server runnable is configured to receive requests from multiple callers located on different ECUs, in which the signals from all callers fan-in to a single callSignal and the related response signals fan-out from a sin- gle returnSignal , the RTE shall ensure that each ISignal of the same Phys- icalChannel referring to the callSignal has exactly one corresponding ISig- nal at the same PhysicalChannel referring to the returnSignal where both of the SystemSignals ( callSignal and returnSignal ) are referenced by the same ClientServerToSignalMapping .
